demo.selection: Fixed 128 validation sections; choose 192x128 rectangle with largest reference-label count. No predictions used.
demo.purpose: Label-rich pipeline smoke test, NOT an unbiased benchmark or evidence of generalization.
demo.coordinate_units: zero-based array indices; physical survey mapping not established

thebe.axis_naming_warning: Author notebook calls the first axis IL; data paper swaps IL/XL wording and contains 1803/1804 and 1537/1573 typos. Use array indices until raw SGY mapping is established.
thebe.annotation_scope: Source describes faults >20 m displacement in a particular AOI, approximately 2-4 km depth. No voxel-wise annotation-completeness mask or confirmed physical sample mapping is supplied here.
thebe.negative_label_policy: Zero is the supplied reference value; it is NOT proof of complete negative interpretation over the whole survey.
thebe.padding_policy: All-zero traces are padding candidates; individual zero-valued samples can be valid waveforms. Amplitude support is distinct from interpretation completeness.
thebe.test_policy: Only file headers/pair counts inspected; no TEST sample plots, statistics, predictions, threshold tuning or model selection.

warnings.interpretation: Data are readable and correctly paired; nonzero anomalies require an explicit support/annotation policy before baseline training.
